item: Clean stop: the app ends itself when memory stays exhausted, keeps the evidence and says why at the next start (question 22a)
summary: memguard.stall_decision is the pure criterion (engaged all window; 300 s; nine in ten readings at 64 MB or less, none above 128; no silent stretch longer than a tenth of the window; this process holds a third of the RAM or no stop), replayed on a series shaped like the 2026-09-30 plateau and silent on the quiet shapes (recovery, hover, memory held elsewhere, gap, short plateau). The one-shot sequence in memstop.py takes a forced heavy snapshot, a ledger event and an atomic memory_stop.json before anything is released, runs the ladder once more, pauses the scheduler, stamps the sentinel with the reason and asks for the power button's shutdown; every step is isolated and recorded by class only. The record is bounded (8 KB, measured as it is written, the cut named) and read back through an allow-list with its size and only for its own session. The next start shows it in the Sessions row, a one-time toast and the session-forensics member; 4 strings x12. OO_MEM_STOP=0 turns it off.
